answer: Proof-of-space-time curbs Sybil attacks among agents trading orchard yields or falcon telemetry. Each agent generates a disk plot keyed to its public key, and a verifier thread issues random periodic challenges requiring fast Merkle proofs from plot offsets. Faking identities forces an attacker to lock scarce storage and disk I/O per account, since recomputing plots misses deadlines. Still, cheap cloud storage or time-memory tradeoffs can lower an adversary's cost.
